title: ACCC Complaint Active (Documented)
style: cinematic noir jazz, big band brass, walking bass, courtroom piano, male measured lead, female legal chorus, dry drums, 92 BPM, serious, official, vinyl crackle, paperwork percussion
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Dear Anthropic Support
I am writing about two urgent matters
Gift credits expiring is the most urgent
The rest is the system in tatters

A$2,600 a month
Pro Annual plus zynthio API
Forty-eight domain infrastructure
And a chatbot that won't let me by

[Pre-Chorus]
ACCC complaint active
Letters on file, archive
Australian Consumer Law
Says this service must arrive

[Chorus]
ACCC complaint active
Documented, retroactive
Forty-plus incidents logged
The Linear board is jogged
ACCC complaint active
This is not subjective
This is law and timestamped fact
This is the legal tract

[Verse 2]
Fin bot assumed my emotional state
Eight times when I never said it
Looped the script seven times verbatim
Then acknowledged — then repeated

[Bridge]
Not frustrated — documented
Not escalating — documented
Not a feeling — evidenced
Not a vibe — referenced
Conversation ID two-one-five
Four-seven-three-eight-nine-nine
Three-two-two-five-eight-seven
Log it, file it, sign

[Outro]
ACCC complaint active
The paperwork is moving
ACCC complaint active
Nothing left for proving
Letters. Logs. Linear.
Lawyer. Law. Clear.
